A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Chain-of-Embedding research. All 33 pages of each version, including Appendices A-D, are available and readable; text comparison and rendered-page checks support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of CoE-R and CoE-C across datasets and models, including benchmark results, ablations, execution timings, and additional experiments in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1-4 and the supplementary analyses in Appendices A and D.

M1.justification: Hidden-state aggregation, magnitude and angle features, and the CoE-R and CoE-C computations remain unchanged in Sections 2-3 and Algorithms 1-2 in Appendix B.1.

E1.justification: Both versions use GSM8K, MATH, CommonsenseQA, TheoremQA, MMLU, and English Belebele for the main evaluation. The additional TruthfulQA comparison and MGSM evaluation across 11 languages are also retained without coverage changes.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same ten baselines, and Table 4 retains ITI and MIND. Comparator membership in the difficulty, multilingual, and PSA strategy comparisons is also unchanged. Newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix C retain the same seven model configurations, zero-shot CoT setup, exact-match correctness labels, AUROC/FPR95/AUPR metrics, output-length limit, prompts, and baseline sampling settings.

E4.justification: The component ablation, task-difficulty, data-ratio, efficiency, multilingual, and out-of-distribution analyses are unchanged. Appendix A.1.2 retains the same PSA strategy experiment, and Appendix D retains the same supplementary plots.

E5.justification: Table 3 retains the same timing summaries with ± values, and Figure 3 retains the same shaded sample variability. There are no changes to seed information, repeated-run reporting, confidence intervals, or significance testing.

E6.justification: The numerical results and reported findings remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1's CoE-C mathematics averages remain 75.22 AUROC, 72.64 FPR95, and 63.36 AUPR.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, score derivations, monotonicity arguments, and robustness proof in Sections 2-3 and 5 and Appendix B are unchanged. No assumptions or proof corrections are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims: label-free, training-free, output-free self-evaluation using hidden-state trajectories, effectiveness across domains and models, and millisecond-level computational overhead.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same interpretations of trajectory features, CoE-C robustness, and performance across tasks and domains. The limitation concerning inaccessible hidden states in closed-source models is unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix C preserves the same model sources, hardware, inference settings, prompts, and baseline hyperparameters. The existing code link moves into the abstract without changing its destination or the disclosed access information.

R1.justification: The introduction replaces Brown et al. (2020) and GLM et al. (2024) with Guo et al. (2025). Appendix A adds citations to Shorinwa et al. (2024), Wang et al. (2024b), Taghanaki and Monteiro (2025), and Liu et al. (2025). These are limited literature updates; the research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 makes small wording and grammar edits, renames Appendix A.2 from label-based correctness estimation to label-based self-evaluation, expands author and contact information, adds acknowledgements, and updates the publication header. The scientific section order and narrative remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves from page 2 to page 1 with a slightly expanded caption. Front matter, references, and portions of Appendix A reflow, and Figure 8's caption receives a grammatical correction. No figures or tables are added, removed, or substantively redesigned.

improvement.justification: v2 refreshes citations and publication presentation while retaining the same methods, empirical evidence, theory, reproducibility information, and limitations. The limited copyediting and Figure 1 relocation leave overall clarity and scientific support essentially unchanged.
